ttl.name: Front Lower Ball Joint Assembly LH

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Front Lower Ball Joint Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Lift up the front of the vehicle.
Move the lower arm up and down by hand (294N{30kgf} or more) and check that the front lower ball joint assembly LH has no play.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Axle Shaft Nut LH

s2.ptxt: Set the SST aligned with the groove of the front drive shaft assembly LH, and using a hammer, unstake the front axle hub nut LH.

item.ptxt: Set SST in the groove with its flat surface facing up.
Never grind the tip of SST with a grinder or similar tool.
When removing the front axle hub nut LH, completely unstake it.
Do not damage the threads of the front drive shaft assembly LH.

s2.ptxt: Using a socket wrench (30mm), remove the front axle hub nut LH.
Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the speed sensor wire and flexible hose.
Remove the bolt and disconnect the speed sensor front LH from the steering knuckle.

atten3.ptxt: Do not allow foreign matter to adhere to the tip and installation part of the speed sensor front LH.

s2.ptxt: Remove the cotter pin and castle nut.
Using SST, disconnect the tie rod end LH from the steering knuckle.

item.ptxt: Do not damage the front disc brake dust cover.
To prevent SST from falling, be sure to suspend it with a string or similar.
Do not damage the ball joint dust cover.
Do not damage the steering knuckle.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the front disc brake caliper assembly LH from the steering knuckle.

atten3.ptxt: Suspend the front disc brake caliper assembly LH with wire or equivalent.

s2.ptxt: Put matchmarks on the disc and axle hub, and remove the disc.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Suspension Arm Sub-assembly Lower NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Push down the front suspension lower arm No.1 LH and disconnect it from the front lower ball joint LH.
Using a plastic hammer, lightly tap the end of the front drive shaft assembly LH to disengage the front drive shaft assembly LH from the front axle assembly LH.

atten4.ptxt: If the engagement is tight, tap the end of the front drive shaft assembly LH using a brass bar and hammer.

s2.ptxt: Push the front axle assembly LH toward the outside of the vehicle and pull the front drive shaft assembly LH out of the front axle assembly LH.

item.ptxt: Do not push the front axle assembly LH out farther than necessary.
Do not damage the drive shaft outboard joint boot.
Do not damage the speed sensor rotor.
Suspend the front drive shaft assembly LH with wire or similar.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and 2 nuts, and remove the front axle assembly LH from the front shock absorber.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Lower Ball Joint Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Using aluminum plates, secure the front axle assembly LH in a vise.
Install the 2 SSTs to the ball joint of the front lower ball joint assembly LH.

atten3.ptxt: Leave a clearance of 1mm between the SST and axle.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the front lower ball joint assembly LH from the front axle assembly LH.

item.ptxt: Install the SST so that A and B of the SST are parallel.
Be sure to apply the wrench at the position shown in the illustration.
Do not damage the ball joint boot of the front lower ball joint assembly LH.
